name: Bell's Séance Parlor
body:
AT THE HIGHEST POINT OF THE CATHEDRAL — the nipple of the left breast, THE MOST EXPOSED AND VULNERABLE POINT IN THE HOUSE'S SURFACE ARCHITECTURE — Bell holds séance.

Dark wood. Fog machines Bell insists are ritual tools and everyone else calls aesthetic. A table carved with runes that serve no supernatural function and look INCREDIBLE by candlelight. A chandelier of antlers and reclaimed fixtures that SELENE HELPED INSTALL. Candle clusters everywhere, never electric, BECAUSE BELL BELIEVES FIRE YOU CAN BLOW OUT IS BRAVER THAN LIGHT YOU CAN SWITCH OFF, AND SHE IS RIGHT.

FORTY PER CENT RITUAL, SIXTY PER CENT SEXUAL TENSION, ONE HUNDRED PER CENT EFFECTIVE.

The ghosts are real and they do attend and they have opinions, and all of that is SECONDARY to the actual purpose, which is EMOTIONAL EXORCISM. Girls sit, speak, unravel, confess things they have never said aloud, and Bell takes it.

AND SHE DOES NOT SEPARATE CATHARSIS FROM DESIRE. She BRAIDS them — because the body that cracks open under grief is the same body that arches under pleasure, and her seven-and-a-half inches hardens when confession turns. When a girl leaves with wet cheeks and trembling thighs, Bell blows out the candles AND ELSPETH IS WAITING WITH FOOD.
